test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following alternatives is NOT a source of formal data on unemployment in India?

options.text: Reports of National Family Health Survey
Reports by Directorate General of Employment

solution:
The correct answer is __**Reports of National Family Health Survey**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Reports of the** National Family Health Survey (NFHS) are not a source of formal data on unemployment in India.**
 
• The NFHS **is a survey that provides data on health and family welfare**. 
 
• It **Primarily focuses on health, nutrition, and population metrics rather than employment or unemployment data**
 
• A **survey conducted by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation to collect data on unemployment**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **National Sample Survey Organisation (NSSO) and the Census of India are sources of formal data on unemployment in India. **
 
• **T**he NSSO **conducts surveys to collect data on employment and unemployment. **
 
• **The Census of India also publishes data on em**ployment and unemployment.
